title: Frostbite
author: Richelle Mead
summary: At a vampire boarding school, Rose Hathaway trains to be a guardian for her best friend Lissa, a royal Moroi. When a major Strigoi attack strikes, the school sends them on a trip to a ski resort and the danger follows.
readIf: you want a fast YA vampire series with banter, training and a forbidden crush.
skipIf: you dislike teen love-triangle drama or want vampires played in a darker register.
